item.title: [CRITICAL] Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
item.description: Some WordPress sites can still be attacked while they install the fix for an actively exploited flaw, according to Umut Bayram, the Picus Security researcher who found it. item.title: [CRITICAL] CISA KEV Alert: CVE-2026-19868 in SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Under Active Exploitation
item.description: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN is affected by CVE-2026-19868. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (M... Action: Mandatory remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Check retail perimeter and server inventory for SonicOS SSLVPN.
